soil.title: Soil N-P-K & pH Analysis
soil.subtitle: Assess soil macronutrient concentrations and receive tailored organic and chemical fertilizer dosage plans.
soil.nitrogen_low: Nitrogen is low — apply urea or ammonium sulfate.
soil.nitrogen_high: Nitrogen is high — reduce nitrogen fertilizer.
soil.phosphorus_low: Phosphorus is low — apply SSP or DAP.
soil.phosphorus_high: Phosphorus is sufficient — avoid excessive phosphate inputs.
soil.potassium_low: Potassium is low — apply muriate of potash (MOP).
soil.potassium_high: Potassium is optimal — no extra potash needed.
soil.ph_acidic: Soil is acidic (pH < 6.0) — apply agricultural lime to neutralize acidity.
soil.ph_alkaline: Soil is alkaline (pH > 7.5) — apply gypsum or organic compost.
soil.balanced: N-P-K and pH levels are well-balanced for most crop varieties.
